pob.what_this_is: PoB-derived. A build PoB saved, exported by pob2opt, loaded back into the pinned engine and compared on canonical identity. Not a gameplay measurement.
pob.xml_byte_note: PoB assigns its own internal numeric item and node IDs, so byte equality is not the test.
